title: Cloud Security: primary meter basis
content:
Cloud Security uses the following tier-specific bases for primary meter basis.

## Basis

Primary quantity unit: Primary meter quantity unit; string.

Included primary quantity: Primary meter quantity included per holding per complete month, prorated by active seconds; decimal.

Smallest billable primary increment: Smallest billable primary meter increment in primary quantity unit; positive decimal.

Minimum primary interval quantity: Minimum primary quantity billed per measured resource interval; decimal.

Excess-usage treatment: Treatment of usage exceeding included allowance; string.

## Tier values

| Security tier | Primary quantity unit | Included primary quantity | Smallest billable primary increment | Minimum primary interval quantity | Excess-usage treatment |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Cloud Security 50 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 100 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 250 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 500 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 1000 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |
| Northbridge Cloud Security 2500 Workloads | workload-hour | 0 | 0.000001 (1e-06) | 0 | billing actual usage |

## Tier comparison

The listed primary meter bases are the same across these six Security tiers.
